verdict.rationale: Brex can be driven without its UI through its documented REST APIs (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments). These use scoped user tokens passed in request headers, and the docs show automation through Pipedream, Zapier, Workato and Postman collections, so unattended programmatic use is supported. However, there is no CLI or CI-specific tooling, and tokens must be created manually in the dashboard. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration guidance, programmatic or service-account credential provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipelines.
